en.explanation:
The correct statements are as follows:

(A) Cr3+ is more stable than Cr2+, thus, Cr2+ act as reducing agent.

(B) Mn2+ is more stable than Mn3+, thus, Mn3+ act as an oxidizing agent.

(C) Both Cr2+ and Mn3+ exhibit d4 electronic configuration.
